turns.q: Is there anything I should pair it with to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
ld pair it with to get the best result?
menu
To get the best result, we recommend pairing your braided rug with a thin open-weave or felt-plus-rubber rug pad.
A rug pad keeps the rug safely in place to prevent slipping, adds extra cushioning underfoot, and protects both the rug backing and your hard floors.
If you choose a rug from our Non-Slip Limited Collection or an Ultra Durable option that includes a built-in anti-skid backing, you won't need a separate rug pad.

turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
to get the best result?
menu
To get the best performance from your rug, start by unrolling it and letting it lay flat for 36 to 48 hours to relax naturally before placing furniture on it.
For routine care, vacuum using a hard surface attachment or suction only, avoiding any beater bar as it can pull the braided fibers.
For cleaning, small Ultra Durable rugs can be machine washed on gentle, while larger sizes can be hosed down outdoors and laid flat to dry completely.
